data.name: Bakhtawar
data.gender_notes: Bakhtawar is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name that symbolizes good fortune and happiness. In Islamic tradition, it is believed to bring prosperity and blessings to the bearer. The name Bakhtawar carries the meaning “Lucky, Fortunate” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Bakhtawar usually hope their child will grow to embody lucky, fortunate and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A Quranic name mentioned in Surah Al-Qamar, verse 46, which means 'those who are blessed with good fortune'.
data.etymology: Bakhtawar belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lucky, Fortunate.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Bakhtawar total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_arabic.name: بختاور
in_arabic.meaning: الشخص الذي يحظى بحظ سعيد في الحياة
in_arabic.long_meaning: بختاور هو اسم مشتق من الكلمة العربية 'بخت' والتي تعني الحظ أو النصيب، و'أور' الذي يعني الزيادة أو النمو. يشير الاسم إلى الشخص الذي يحظى بحظ سعيد في الحياة، ويتميز بالنجاح والتوفيق في جميع أمور الحياة. يعتبر هذا الاسم من الأسماء التي تحمل معاني إيجابية ومرغوبة في الثقافة الإسلامية.

in_urdu.name: بختاور
in_urdu.meaning: وہ شخص جس کی زندگی میں خوش قسمتی ہو
in_urdu.long_meaning: بختاور ایک فارسی-عربی مکسڈ نام ہے جو 'بخت' سے ماخوذ ہے جس کا مطلب ہے قسمت یا نصیب، اور 'اور' جس کا مطلب ہے زیادہ یا بڑھنا۔ یہ نام اس شخص کے لئے استعمال ہوتا ہے جس کی زندگی میں خوش قسمتی اور کامیابی ہو۔ یہ نام جنوبی ایشیائی مسلمانوں کے درمیان میں خاصی اہمیت رکھتا ہے اور اکثر ایسے بچوں کے لئے منتخب کیا جاتا ہے جن کی زندگی میں خوشحالی اور کامیابی کی آرزو کی جاتی ہے۔

in_hindi.name: बख्तावर
in_hindi.long_meaning: बख्तावर एक नाम है जो अरबी और फारसी शब्दों से मिलकर बना है। 'बख्त' का अर्थ है किस्मत या भाग्य, और 'अवर' का अर्थ है अधिक या बढ़ना। यह नाम उस व्यक्ति के लिए प्रयोग किया जाता है जिसकी जिंदगी में खुशकिस्मती और सफलता हो। भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में यह नाम विशेष महत्व रखता है और अक्सर ऐसे बच्चों के लिए चुना जाता है जिनकी जिंदगी में समृद्धि और सफलता की कामना की जाती है।

in_pashto.name: بختاور
in_pashto.meaning: هغه کس چې په ژوند کې يې خوشحاله وي
in_pashto.long_meaning: بختاور د يو نوم دی چې د 'بخت' څخه اخستل شوی دی، چې د قسمت يا نصيب معنی لري، او 'اور' چې د زيات يا ډېرښت معنی لري. دا نوم د هغه چا لپاره کارول کېږي چې په ژوند کې يې خوشحاله وي او بریاليتوب ولري. په پښتني کلتور کې دا نوم خاصه اهميت لري او ډیری وخت داسې ماشومانو لپاره غوره کیږي چې په ژوند کې يې بریاليتوب او خوشحالي وي.

in_english.name: Bakhtawar
in_english.meaning: A person who has good fortune and success in life
in_english.long_meaning: Bakhtawar is a name derived from the Arabic word 'bakht', meaning fortune or luck, and 'awar', meaning bringer or bestower. In Islamic tradition, this name signifies a person who is blessed with good fortune, success, and prosperity in life. The name has its roots in Arabic etymology and is mentioned in various historical contexts as a symbol of divine favor and benevolence. The spiritual significance of this name lies in its connotation of positivity, hope, and divine guidance. In modern times, the name Bakhtawar is used across various Muslim cultures, reflecting its universal appeal and timeless significance.

data.cultural_impact: The name Bakhtawar holds a rich cultural significance in various regions, especially in Pakistan and India, where it is popular among Muslims. The name Bakht signifies joy and happiness, while the suffix 'awar' means holder or possessor. So, Bakhtawar is often translated to mean the 'holder of joy and happiness'. In some communities, it is believed that this name can bring good fortune and prosperity to the person carrying it. Parties and celebrations often take place in honor of a newborn baby girl being named Bakhtawar, adding to the joyous atmosphere.
data.spiritual_significance: In Islamic tradition, the name Bakhtawar holds a deep spiritual significance. The Quran encourages Muslims to seek happiness and good fortune in both this world and the hereafter (Ar-Ra'd 13:28). The name Bakhtawar serves as a reminder of the eternal happiness and joy that awaits believers in paradise. Additionally, the name can be seen as a reflection of the inner peace and contentment that comes from a strong faith and obedience to Allah. Therefore, Bakhtawar is not just a beautiful name; it is a reminder of the joy, prosperity, and ultimate happiness that awaits believers in the divine presence of Allah.
